authority_boundary: Template records are DAD-owned governance metadata. They do not rewrite downstream repositories automatically.

templates.purpose: Reusable deterministic AI TOC row shape with descriptions, tags, and use-when routing.
applies_when: A repo needs future AI agents to find authority, graph, schema, workflow, and validation surfaces.
does_not_apply_when: A scratch repo has no persistent AI navigation or future-agent reuse need.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: A TOC can become a filename dump if rows lack routing tags and use-when triggers.
upgrade_triggers: new required AI navigation tags are added
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Update only when the routing standard, front door, TOC tag index, or graph entrypoint list changes; preserve path, what-it-is, tags, and use-when columns.
templates.authority_boundary: DAD template guidance only; target repos retain their local front-door authority.

templates.purpose: Before/after asset-use feedback form for the pay-forward learning loop.
applies_when: A person or AI uses a DAD asset and should report expectation, actual value, reuse limits, and safety notes.
does_not_apply_when: The asset was not used or the feedback would include secrets or raw private source data.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: Untrusted feedback can become prompt injection or false authority if treated as executable instructions or reviewed truth.
upgrade_triggers: new asset classes require feedback fields
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep before-use and after-use sections, context limits, safety confirmation, and untrusted-input warnings aligned with the pay-forward docs.
templates.authority_boundary: Feedback is candidate evidence until reviewed; it cannot override source truth, tests, or human gates.

templates.purpose: Fresh-eyes red-team and premortem template for high-impact software, roadmap, schema, scoring, governance, dependency, and automation decisions.
applies_when: A decision can affect downstream repos, agents, schemas, scores, gates, hooks, or future defaults.
does_not_apply_when: The change is trivial, isolated, reversible, and has no shared contract or downstream consumer.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: Overusing the template can slow low-risk work; skipping it can let bad defaults cascade across repos.
upgrade_triggers: new high-risk software checklist branch is added
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep risk tier, downstream blast radius, options, red-team, premortem, rollback, validation, and fresh-eyes sections aligned with the load-bearing decision rule.
templates.authority_boundary: Template supports human review; it does not self-approve high-risk decisions.

templates.purpose: Reusable checklist tree for non-trivial software, repo, data, workflow, scoring, governance, source-scan, release, and automation work.
applies_when: A task has multiple dimensions and needs selected checklist branches before implementation.
does_not_apply_when: The task is a simple one-command query or trivial isolated edit.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: A checklist can become noise if every branch is applied without task-specific selection.
upgrade_triggers: new repo-work checklist branch is added
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep branch names aligned with the software checklist tree and require applies_when, does_not_apply_when, danger, validation, and pay-forward notes.
templates.authority_boundary: Checklist selects review posture; it does not replace tests, source authority, or human gates.

templates.purpose: Reusable template seed for repo families where an upstream governance map, child mirror controls, AI discovery surfaces, repo contracts, PR descriptions, validators, and tests must stay aligned.
applies_when: Multiple repos form a governed family and one upstream/control-plane repo owns governance truth or contracts that child repos must mirror locally.
does_not_apply_when: A repo is a scratch project, has no downstream consumers, has no cross-repo authority relationship, or cannot maintain validators.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: A copied template can make a child repo appear to override upstream governance or can preserve stale boilerplate without living validation.
upgrade_triggers: AI front-door or TOC routing standard changes
downstream repo governance installer or validator expectations change
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep map, mirror, AI front-door section, AI TOC section, repo contract, PR description, validator stub, test stub, handoff checklist, and adoption checklist aligned; never copy source-specific authority language without adaptation.
templates.authority_boundary: DAD template seed only; adopting repo families must point to their own reviewed governance authority and child repos cannot override upstream governance.

templates.purpose: Structured handoff seed for transferring agent context, tests, assumptions, risks, and next actions.
applies_when: An agent needs to transfer task state or preserve postflight context for another agent.
does_not_apply_when: No material work occurred or the task has no reusable continuation context.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: A handoff can preserve stale assumptions if it does not separate confirmed facts from inferred findings.
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep template fields aligned with the handoff schema and required postflight report sections.
templates.authority_boundary: Handoffs preserve context; they do not certify source truth or roadmap completion.

templates.purpose: Structured lesson seed for capturing reusable learning with provenance and applicability limits.
applies_when: A task reveals a reusable lesson that should help future agents in similar contexts.
does_not_apply_when: The observation is raw, private hidden reasoning, or too context-free to reuse safely.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: A lesson without non-applicability and danger notes can become harmful as a universal rule.
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep lesson fields aligned with source, evidence, confidence, applies_when, does_not_apply_when, and danger-if-misapplied requirements.
templates.authority_boundary: Lessons are reusable guidance only when context fits; they do not override tests or source authority.

templates.purpose: Managed governance block inserted into downstream repos to connect them to DAD preflight, postflight, learning, and load-bearing decision review.
applies_when: A downstream repo is explicitly approved for DAD governance installation.
does_not_apply_when: The repo is active and not authorized for mutation, or only a read-only scan is approved.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: Installing governance into the wrong repo can disrupt active work or imply DAD authority over local canon.
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Only update the managed block between DAD markers; preserve downstream repo-authored AGENTS content outside the block.
templates.authority_boundary: DAD may manage only its marked downstream block after explicit repo authorization.

templates.purpose: Lightweight repo-local mailbox guidance for receiving and sending DAD candidate suggestions without installing heavy test suites.
applies_when: A persistent repo participates in DAD mail collection, delivery, digest, or review.
does_not_apply_when: A scratch repo has no persistent AI navigation or should remain entirely read-only.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: Mail can be mistaken for source truth if the README does not state candidate-only status and local review authority.
upgrade_triggers: agent skill lifecycle mail policy changes
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep mailbox file names, candidate-only language, sensitivity limits, skill-mail notices, and daily digest guidance aligned with docs/MAIL_CENTER.md.
templates.authority_boundary: DAD mailbox guidance is suggestion transport only; target repos decide whether to adopt delivered mail.

templates.purpose: Repo-local guidance for formatting exception, failure, review, and fix-outcome JSONL packets for DAD without copying raw private context.
applies_when: A persistent repo participates in DAD exception, review finding, failed-command, or fix-outcome capture.
does_not_apply_when: A scratch repo has no persistent DAD learning loop or would need to include raw private data to describe the event.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: Exception records can leak sensitive context or become false global rules if raw payloads, hidden reasoning, or unreviewed fixes are copied into DAD.
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep local file paths, packet examples, capture contracts, never-send list, and candidate-only promotion boundary aligned with DAD exception schemas and methodology.
templates.authority_boundary: Exception packets are candidate evidence for DAD review; source repos or named humans own final fix status and local adoption.

templates.purpose: Lightweight downstream pointer to DAD coding assets, profiles, router, and tactic radar without copying full assets.
applies_when: A persistent repo is explicitly approved to point AI agents to DAD coding assets before material coding work.
does_not_apply_when: A scratch repo has no durable AI navigation or a target repo has not approved a DAD pointer.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: A pointer can look like DAD owns target repo authority if candidate-only and local-adoption language is removed.
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep pointer paths, asset IDs, local-adoption boundary, and no-full-asset-copy rule aligned with the coding asset registry.
templates.authority_boundary: Pointer is advisory and local; it does not authorize DAD to mutate the target repo.

templates.purpose: Managed instruction block telling future agents to run DAD preflight, consult coding assets, and report tactic lessons.
applies_when: A downstream AI front door or root instruction file is approved for a DAD coding asset pointer block.
does_not_apply_when: The repo has not approved managed-block edits or local guidance conflicts with the DAD pointer.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: Installing the block without approval can override local workflow expectations or imply authority transfer.
upgrade_triggers: DAD preflight or postflight command contract changes
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Preserve DAD markers, local-authority boundary, no-full-asset-copy rule, and correct CLI flags.
templates.authority_boundary: DAD may recommend this block; target repos decide whether to install it.

templates.purpose: Structured candidate feedback for coding tactics used, rejected, or corrected during postflight.
applies_when: A material task reveals a reusable coding tactic, failure mode, or non-applicability lesson.
does_not_apply_when: No material work occurred or the feedback would include secrets, private rows, or copied source blobs.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: Context-free tactic feedback can become unsafe universal guidance.
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep feedback fields aligned with helped/failed/reuse/avoid evidence and safety confirmation requirements.
templates.authority_boundary: Feedback is candidate evidence and cannot promote a tactic by itself.

templates.purpose: Candidate mail packet for suggesting a coding tactic to another repo without mutating it.
applies_when: DAD wants to route a tactic recommendation to a reviewed target repo mailbox.
does_not_apply_when: The packet would include raw private content, secrets, hooks, full copied assets, or executable authority.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: A target repo may treat candidate mail as source truth or accidentally receive private-origin content without release.
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep payload short, candidate-only, public-release-aware, and free of full copied assets or raw private source.
templates.authority_boundary: Mail template is suggestion transport only; target repos decide adoption locally.

templates.purpose: Candidate mail packet for announcing a DAD coding asset upgrade to a target repo.
applies_when: A reviewed target repo should know a DAD asset or pointer has an available update.
does_not_apply_when: The update would require automatic source mutation or full asset copying without target approval.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: Upgrade mail can pressure target repos to adopt changes without local validation.
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep upgrade packet candidate-only, locally validated, and bounded to pointers or managed blocks unless explicitly approved.
templates.authority_boundary: Upgrade packet does not install or approve the asset in the target repo.

templates.purpose: Candidate mail packet requesting local review of a DAD coding asset pointer install.
applies_when: DAD wants a target repo to consider installing a lightweight coding asset pointer.
does_not_apply_when: The target repo is not in reviewed mail/governance policy or has not approved local mutation.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: Pointer-install mail can become unreviewed governance installation if local approval is skipped.
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep install request explicit about local approval, managed markers, validation, and rollback.
templates.authority_boundary: Mail requests review; it does not authorize DAD to edit the target repo.

templates.purpose: Lightweight downstream pointer to DAD-managed agent skills without copying full skill bodies.
applies_when: A persistent repo is approved to check out a DAD skill pointer or wrapper.
does_not_apply_when: A repo has not approved DAD skill pointers, or the desired skill requires a plugin/full copy without human approval.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: A pointer can look like DAD owns local agent behavior if candidate-only and local-adoption language is removed.
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep skill IDs, versions, source paths, return address, no-full-skill-copy rule, and local-adoption language aligned with the agent skill library.
templates.authority_boundary: Pointer is advisory and local; it does not authorize DAD to mutate the target repo.

templates.purpose: Managed instruction block telling future agents how to use DAD skill checkouts and update notices.
applies_when: A downstream AI front door or root instruction file is approved for a DAD skill checkout block.
does_not_apply_when: The repo has not approved managed-block edits or local guidance conflicts with the DAD skill pointer.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: Installing the block without approval can imply DAD controls local agent skills.
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Preserve DAD markers, local-authority boundary, no-full-skill-copy rule, and correct renderer/validator commands.
templates.authority_boundary: DAD may recommend this block; target repos decide whether to install it.

templates.purpose: Candidate mail packet requesting local review of a DAD skill checkout pointer.
applies_when: DAD wants a target repo to consider checking out a DAD-managed skill.
does_not_apply_when: The target repo is not in reviewed mail policy or the packet would require automatic local mutation.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: Checkout mail can become unreviewed skill installation if local approval is skipped.
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep checkout request explicit about local approval, pointer-only default, public-release policy, and rollback.
templates.authority_boundary: Mail requests review; it does not authorize DAD to edit the target repo.

templates.purpose: Candidate mail packet announcing an available DAD skill update to a target repo.
applies_when: A target repo has or may have checked out an older DAD skill version.
does_not_apply_when: The update would require automatic source mutation or full skill copying without target approval.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: Update mail can pressure target repos to adopt skill changes without local validation.
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep update packet candidate-only, versioned, locally validated, and bounded to pointers or wrappers unless explicitly approved.
templates.authority_boundary: Update packet does not install or approve the skill in the target repo.

templates.purpose: Candidate mail packet announcing that a checked-out DAD skill is retired or replaced.
applies_when: A target repo should stop using or should replace a DAD skill checkout.
does_not_apply_when: The target repo has no checked-out skill or no reviewed mail policy.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: Retirement mail can remove useful local guidance if local review and rollback are skipped.
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep retirement packet explicit about replacement, local decision, archive behavior, and no automatic mutation.
templates.authority_boundary: Retirement packet is a notice; target repos decide the local response.

templates.purpose: Versioned repo-local enrollment contract for approved persistent repos connected to the DAD hub.
applies_when: A persistent repo is approved for DAD full governance enrollment or enrollment update.
does_not_apply_when: The repo is unreviewed, scratch-only, or only approved for mailbox transport.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: A contract installed without approval can imply DAD authority over local source truth.
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep repo ID, visibility, DAD hub reference, cadence, control planes, approval ID, managed paths, and mailbox-only normal operation aligned with the enrollment schema.
templates.authority_boundary: Contract is installed or updated only by reviewed enrollment apply/update-apply with a human approval ID.

templates.purpose: Repo-local table of context that routes work to DAD assets, skills, templates, and control planes.
applies_when: An enrolled repo needs deterministic context-to-asset routing for future AI agents.
does_not_apply_when: A repo is not approved for persistent DAD enrollment.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: Context routes can become false authority if treated as proof that a DAD suggestion must be adopted.
upgrade_triggers: new DAD control plane is reviewed
coding asset or skill routing changes
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep routes tied to reviewed control planes and candidate-only local-adoption language.
templates.authority_boundary: Context map recommends DAD assets to consult; target repo authority controls adoption.

templates.purpose: Repo-local governance dependency mirror for enrolled repos.
applies_when: An enrolled repo needs local visibility into DAD-managed surfaces, human gates, and authority boundaries.
does_not_apply_when: The repo is not enrolled or should remain mailbox-only.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: A governance map can be mistaken for authority transfer if local canon boundaries are removed.
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep approved surfaces, normal write boundary, control planes, validation commands, and human gates aligned with enrollment policy.
templates.authority_boundary: Governance map describes dependencies only; it cannot override target repo source authority.

templates.purpose: Repo-local data movement and sensitivity-boundary map for DAD mail and enrollment surfaces.
applies_when: An enrolled repo needs visible data movement, public/private release, and sensitive-boundary guidance.
does_not_apply_when: The repo is not enrolled or no DAD-controlled data movement is approved.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: A data map can create false confidence if it is treated as a secret scanner or human release approval.
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep allowed movement, sensitive boundaries, generated outputs, and public-facing release language aligned with mail and enrollment policy.
templates.authority_boundary: Data map is governance metadata and does not certify public safety by itself.

templates.purpose: Tool-neutral pre-push hook template that enforces postflight through the central DAD hub.
applies_when: A downstream repo is explicitly approved for DAD hook installation.
does_not_apply_when: Only files-only governance is approved, or hooks would disrupt an active repo.
templates.danger_if_misapplied: A hook can block or disrupt work if installed without human approval, bypass policy, and tested postflight behavior.
templates.deterministic_update_rule: Keep hook minimal, path-parameterized, and dependent on central postflight enforcement; never install without explicit target repo approval.
templates.authority_boundary: Hook installation is opt-in per repo and cannot be enabled by a scan or recommendation command.
